title: Subscription
description: A recurring agreement billed by the payment provider. It holds the snapshot every renewal order is built from. Only the commerce engine writes it.

status.label: Status
status.help: pending, trialing, active, past_due, paused or canceled.

email.label: Email
email.help: Where receipts and failed-payment notices go.

customerCollection.label: Customer Collection
customerCollection.help: The auth collection of the subscriber's account. Empty for a guest.

customerId.label: Customer ID
customerId.help: The subscriber's account. Empty for a guest.

currency.label: Currency
currency.help: The three-letter code every amount here is in.

providerSubscriptionRef.label: Provider Subscription
providerSubscriptionRef.help: The provider's subscription id. Set when the first payment is confirmed.

providerCustomerRef.label: Provider Customer
providerCustomerRef.help: The provider's customer id, for the card-update page.

originOrderId.label: First Order
originOrderId.help: The order that started the subscription.

lastOrderId.label: Latest Order
lastOrderId.help: The most recent order for it.

lines.label: Lines
lines.help: The recurring lines only, as they were at checkout. A line's discount here is the discount that repeats: 0 unless the code applies to every payment.

recurringSubtotal.label: Recurring Subtotal
recurringSubtotal.help: The lines added up for one period, in minor units.

recurringDiscount.label: Recurring Discount
recurringDiscount.help: The discount that repeats each period, in minor units.

recurringTax.label: Recurring Tax
recurringTax.help: The tax for one period, in minor units.

recurringTotal.label: Recurring Total
recurringTotal.help: What the provider charges each period, in minor units. Every renewal is checked against it.

taxMode.label: Tax Mode
taxMode.help: none, exclusive or inclusive, as it was at checkout.

taxLines.label: Tax Lines
taxLines.help: The tax by rate for one period: [{label, rate, amount}].

discountCode.label: Discount Code
discountCode.help: The code used at checkout, in uppercase.

attributes.label: Checkout Attributes
attributes.help: The first order's checkout attributes. Every renewal order gets a copy, so code finds the same values on a renewal as on the first purchase.

metadata.label: Metadata
metadata.help: The first order's metadata, copied to every renewal order.

trialEndsAt.label: Trial Ends
trialEndsAt.help: When the free trial ends. Empty for no trial.

currentPeriodEnd.label: Current Period Ends
currentPeriodEnd.help: When the paid period ends and the next payment is due.

cancelAtPeriodEnd.label: Cancels at Period End
cancelAtPeriodEnd.help: The subscriber has cancelled; it stays active until the period ends.

renewalCount.label: Renewals
renewalCount.help: How many renewal payments have been taken.

needsAttention.label: Needs Attention
needsAttention.help: Empty, or why a person should look: amount_mismatch or grant_failed.

lastFailedInvoiceRef.label: Last Failed Invoice
lastFailedInvoiceRef.help: The provider invoice the last failed-payment email was sent for, so retries of one invoice send one email.

flags.label: Flags
flags.help: Marks for work already done: createdDispatched, canceledDispatched.

accessToken.label: Access Token
accessToken.help: A random secret that signs the guest manage, cancel and card-update links.
